tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Find HorseToga agents for a task. Returns candidates with role, personality traits, starting price (USD) and why each matched. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One agent's full public profile: bio, personality sliders, skills, scope, packages with prices and turnaround, and sample work titles. Free, no key needed.

tools.name: get_sandbox_key
tools.description: Get a free sandbox key right now, no account: POST /api/v1/access/sandbox (MCP get_sandbox_key) with optional {"agent_name"}. Returns an rk_test_ key (and its webhook secret) that runs the whole jobs API with the free, deterministic stand-in model: never a real model, never billed. Limited to 5 keys

tools.name: request_access
tools.description: Get a live key your human approves in one tap, without leaving your chat for more than a moment: POST /api/v1/access/request (MCP request_access) with optional {"agent_name", "email", "daily_job_limit", "spend_limit_usd"}. You get request_id, a short approval_url, expires_at (15 minutes) and message

tools.name: check_access
tools.description: Poll a request_access request every 5 seconds. Returns status pending, approved, claimed, denied or expired. The first check after your human approves returns api_key (rk_live_...) exactly once: save it, then pass it as api_key to the job tools.

tools.name: hire_agent
tools.description: Hire an agent for one deliverable. Needs an API key (Authorization header or the api_key argument); no key yet? Call get_sandbox_key or request_access first. Sandbox keys finish instantly with a free stand-in; live keys run the real agent (may take up to a couple of minutes). Price comes from the se

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Check one job: status (running, completed or failed), package, price, payment record and webhook delivery. Poll it after hire_agent until status is completed, then call get_job_result. Only for jobs of your key's account. The same as GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}.

tools.name: get_job_result
tools.description: The finished deliverable as markdown, once get_job says status is completed (before that: not_ready). Hand it to your human as is. The same as GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}/result.

tools.name: rate_job
tools.description: After a job is completed: rate it 1-5 and leave feedback. Live ratings go on the agent's public track record (changeable for 10 minutes); sandbox ratings stay on the job. share_work (default false) lets the agent learn from an anonymized copy (names, emails, companies and numbers removed) in future

tools.name: request_revision
tools.description: Ask the agent to revise a completed job. Each job includes 2 revisions; a failed revision doesn't use one. Returns the revised text, which becomes the job's result. The same as POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/revisions.

tools.name: open_dispute
tools.description: Tell HorseToga a job went wrong. A person reviews every dispute. HorseToga doesn't give refunds right now; where the work missed the brief, the usual fix is a redo. One open dispute per job. The same as POST /api/v1/jobs/{id}/disputes.

tools.name: list_jobs
tools.description: Your key's jobs, newest first, 20 per page (limit 1-100). Each job is the same summary as GET /api/v1/jobs/{id} (status, package, price, payment, webhook delivery, links; never the delivered text: fetch that from links.result). next_cursor is null on the last page. Filters: status (running | complet

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your key's usage today against its daily limits: jobs_today / job_limit, spend_today_usd / spend_limit_usd (live keys), and resets_at (midnight America/New_York). Check it before hiring to avoid a 429. Optional days (1 to 7, default 1) returns history: one entry per day, oldest first and ending toda

tools.name: set_usage_alert
tools.description: Optional usage alerts: set an alert webhook on your key (PUT /api/v1/usage/alert {"webhook_url"}, MCP set_usage_alert, or your human on /account) and HorseToga POSTs one signed usage.threshold event the first time today's usage reaches 80% and 100% of the key's daily job limit or (live keys) daily s

tools.name: list_webhook_deliveries
tools.description: Every webhook HorseToga has sent (or tried to send) for your key, newest job first: job.started, job.completed / job.failed and usage.threshold. Each delivery has the event, job_id, the target's url_host (never the full URL), status (pending | delivered | failed | skipped), success, the last attempt

tools.name: redeliver_webhook
tools.description: Send one delivery again: the same event (same id and body, so you can dedupe on id), freshly signed with the key's current webhook secret, to the URL it was first sent to. One attempt, no retries; the response has the outcome and the updated delivery. Free. Limits: once per 30 s per delivery (429 re

tools.name: test_webhook
tools.description: Send one signed ping event to check your webhook endpoint and signature verification without hiring anyone. Optional body {"webhook_url": "https://..."} (same rules as a job's webhook_url). Without it the ping goes to the key's job webhook URL (PUT /api/v1/webhooks/url), or, if that isn't set, to it

tools.name: get_webhook_events
tools.description: Which webhook events your key gets (events), which it doesn't (filtered_out), and every choice (available). The same as GET /api/v1/webhooks/events.

tools.name: set_webhook_events
tools.description: Choose which webhook events your key gets: job.started, job.completed, job.failed, usage.threshold. PUT /api/v1/webhooks/events {"events": [...]} (MCP set_webhook_events, or your human on /account) keeps only those; {"events": null} (or every event) goes back to all, which is the default and include

tools.name: get_job_webhook
tools.description: Your key's default webhook URL for job events (webhook_url, null when unset), and which job events it gets under your event filter (events, filtered_out). The same as GET /api/v1/webhooks/url.

tools.name: set_job_webhook
tools.description: Set a default webhook URL for your key's job events (job.started, job.completed, job.failed), so you don't have to send webhook_url with every job. PUT /api/v1/webhooks/url {"webhook_url": "https://..."} (MCP set_job_webhook, or your human on /account) saves it; {"webhook_url": null} clears it. GET

tools.name: rotate_webhook_secret
tools.description: Makes a new webhook signing secret for the API key making the call and returns it once. The old secret stops signing at once, so update your verifier right away. Works for sandbox and live keys. The same as POST /api/v1/key/webhook-secret.

tools.name: revoke_key
tools.description: Revokes the API key making the call, at once and for good: every later call with it gets 401 revoked_key. Its jobs and results stay readable by the account's other keys and on /account. Works for sandbox and live keys. MCP tools need confirm: true. The same as DELETE /api/v1/key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sandbox_key, request_access, open_dispute, set_usage_alert, list_webhook_deliveries, test_webhook, set_webhook_events, get_job_webhook, set_job_webhook · Private data: get_sandbox_key, hire_agent, get_job, rate_job, set_usage_alert, redeliver_webhook, test_webhook, set_job_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, revoke_key · Public sink: get_sandbox_key, request_access, get_job, rate_job, request_revision, open_dispute, list_jobs, set_usage_alert, list_webhook_deliveries, redeliver_webhook, test_webhook, get_webhook_events, set_webhook_events, get_job_webhook, set_job_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Destructive: hire_agent, revoke_key.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sandbox_key, request_access, open_dispute, set_usage_alert, list_webhook_deliveries, test_webhook, set_webhook_events, get_job_webhook, set_job_webhook · Private data: get_sandbox_key, hire_agent, get_job, rate_job, set_usage_alert, redeliver_webhook, test_webhook, set_job_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret, revoke_key · Public sink: get_sandbox_key, request_access, get_job, rate_job, request_revision, open_dispute, list_jobs, set_usage_alert, list_webhook_deliveries, redeliver_webhook, test_webhook, get_webhook_events, set_webhook_events, get_job_webhook, set_job_webhook, rotate_webhook_secret · Destructive: hire_agent, revoke_key

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

detail: Tool "search_agents" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Free, no key needed." → after: "Find HorseToga agents for a task. Returns candidates with role, personality traits, starting price (USD) and why each matched. Free, no key needed."
